'''Anna Kaslow''' is an [[ally]].  She first appears in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. She can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[Independence Square]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Luck]]

Gain 2 [[Clue token]]s when Anna Kaslow joins you.
